name: cfg-router-cache-aware
about: router.tokenSaver.cacheAwareSwitching（router/policy/RouterCachePolicy.ts）：第一轮判 simple 落到 bbx/cheap，回复的 usage 里 90% 是缓存读；第二轮判 complex 想切到 bbx/big，按 stats.modelPricing 估算留在 cheap 的缓存成本（0.46E）与切到 big 的预填成本（0.3E），minSavingsRatio=0 时切换（mutation switched）。比较第二轮落到的模型与 router/events.jsonl。
config:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  model: bbx/deterministic
  maxContextTokens: 65536
  maxOutputTokens: 8192
model:
  providers:
    bbx:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        deterministic:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
        judge:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
        cheap:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
        big:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
telemetry:
  enabled: false
router:
  enabled: true
  tokenSaver:
    judge: bbx/judge
    defaultTier: simple
    cacheAwareSwitching:
      enabled: true
      minSavingsRatio: 0
    tiers:
      simple:
        model: bbx/cheap
      complex:
        model: bbx/big
  stats:
    modelPricing:
      bbx/cheap:
        input: 1
        output: 1
        cacheRead: 0.4
      bbx/big:
        input: 0.3
        output: 1
